main_visual_claim: Class_07 occupies the high signed-effect and high-correlation region globally, and its sample-level values show a coherent positive internal trend that supports the highlighted global point.

primary_panel.role: Primary global class-level scatter showing signed effect against correlation with Class_07 highlighted.
primary_panel.justification: The global panel carries the main comparison across all classes, the focus location, sample-size encoding, and supporting FDR outline.

support_panels.role: Subordinate detail panel expanding the highlighted class into sample-level effect and response values by subgroup.
support_panels.justification: The support panel has eighteen sample marks, subgroup coding, a fitted trend, and the class-level point, so its smaller right-side area is justified.

issues_found: First render used an overlong headline that clipped at the right edge and crowded the panel titles.
A low-value Class_11 text label competed with the legend in the lower-right region of the global panel.
fixes_applied: Shortened the headline and increased vertical separation between the header strip and panel titles.
Removed the crowded Class_11 text label while retaining the global point and group legend.
remaining_risks: FDR is intentionally limited to a supporting outline and label, so viewers should not interpret it as the primary encoding.
